entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid had scheduled a private meet..."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid had scheduled a private meeting with me, but he didn't specify what it was about.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, Deivid. Please come in.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Deivid. Please come in."
entries.menuText: "Yes, Deivid. Please come in."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Mr. President. May I come in?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. May I come in?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a knock on the door."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a knock on the door.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Take a seat, Mr. Wisci.""
entries.dialogueText: "Take a seat, Mr. Wisci."
entries.menuText: "Take a seat, Mr. Wisci."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He slowly made his way towards the..."
entries.dialogueText: He slowly made his way towards the chair in front of my desk and sat down.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""First of all, thank you for your t..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, thank you for your time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Anything for you, Deivid.""
entries.dialogueText: "Anything for you, Deivid."
entries.menuText: "Anything for you, Deivid."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't mention it. What's wrong?""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't mention it. What's wrong?"
entries.menuText: "Don't mention it. What's wrong?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Please make it quick. I have other..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please make it quick. I have other business to attend to."
entries.menuText: "Please make it quick. I have other business to attend to."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Of course. I will be as fast as I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I will be as fast as I can."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I wanted to ask you how you are do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to ask you how you are doing."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It looks like war is truly upon us.""
entries.dialogueText: "It looks like war is truly upon us."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It must be taking a toll on you, j..."
entries.dialogueText: "It must be taking a toll on you, just like it did on me all those years ago."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""But of course, I won't presume to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But of course, I won't presume to understand what you are going through right now."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I was never the leader of a nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was never the leader of a nation during wartime, after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm fine. Thanks for asking.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm fine. Thanks for asking."
entries.menuText: "I'm fine. Thanks for asking."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am only interested in the result..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am only interested in the results of this war. Nothing more."
entries.menuText: "I am only interested in the results of this war. Nothing more."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Honestly. I am tired, Deivid. I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly. I am tired, Deivid. I am tired of it all."
entries.menuText: "Honestly. I am tired, Deivid. I am tired of it all."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Please, be sure to take some time..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, be sure to take some time for yourself."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Oh, I know the feeling. Trust me...."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I know the feeling. Trust me. I know."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Sometimes you just want to throw a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sometimes you just want to throw away all the responsibility and escape."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Perhaps into the wilderness, perha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps into the wilderness, perhaps to the sea."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""That's very good.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very good."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""If you ignore the mental fatigue,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you ignore the mental fatigue, it will slowly creep in on you. It will poison your thoughts."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Please be sure to take some time f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please be sure to take some time for yourself amid all this."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci

entries.dialogueText: "If you ignore the mental fatigue, it will slowly creep in on you. It will poison your thoughts."

entries.title: Player: ""I'm not in the mood for lectures.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not in the mood for lectures."
entries.menuText: "I'm not in the mood for lectures."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for your valuable advice.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your valuable advice."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for your valuable advice."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Don't mind me. I'm just an old man..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't mind me. I'm just an old man getting ahead of himself."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Thank you for taking my advice ove..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for taking my advice over the years."

entries.dialogueText: "That would be nice, wouldn't it? But I could never do that."
entries.menuText: "That would be nice, wouldn't it? But I could never do that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Exactly. That is what I want..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Exactly. That is what I want to do. I want to get away from this office."
entries.menuText: "Yes. Exactly. That is what I want to do. I want to get away from this office."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It is good to fantasize, but unfor..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is good to fantasize, but unfortunately, men of power like yourself are bound by duty and their responsibility to the nation."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Unfortunately, men of power are bo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, men of power are bound by duty and their responsibility to the nation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He started coughing."
entries.dialogueText: He started coughing.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It has been many years since you w..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been many years since you were in my classroom."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""What a privilege for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "What a privilege for me."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I had the chance to watch my stude..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had the chance to watch my student grow into a fine and strong leader in my lifetime. What a privilege indeed."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""You have brought reform to Sordlan..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have brought reform to Sordland. You, my student, actually did it."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""You don't know how proud I was to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't know how proud I was to be alongside you."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""You tried your best to bring refor..."
entries.dialogueText: "You tried your best to bring reform to Sordland. That is valiant in itself."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It is okay to feel frustrated by f..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is okay to feel frustrated by failure. But change unfortunately doesn't happen easily."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""You paved a path for future genera..."
entries.dialogueText: "You paved a path for future generations to follow, and they will remember you for it."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""If there is one thing I learned fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there is one thing I learned from you, it is that power changes people."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It makes them do things that were..."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes them do things that were not imaginable before."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I hope you are not trying to take..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are not trying to take a stab at me right now, Deivid."
entries.menuText: "I hope you are not trying to take a stab at me right now, Deivid."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It's just a simple observation. Do..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's just a simple observation. Don't pay heed to this old man."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""True. But it changed me for better.""
entries.dialogueText: "True. But it changed me for better."
entries.menuText: "True. But it changed me for better."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Perhaps. But it also takes its tol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps. But it also takes its toll."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Desperate times require desperate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Desperate times require desperate measures."
entries.menuText: "Desperate times require desperate measures."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""That is correct. But sometimes the..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is correct. But sometimes the ends do not justify the means."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This was only the beginning. Much..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was only the beginning. Much more awaits on the horizon."
entries.menuText: "This was only the beginning. Much more awaits on the horizon."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I still can't believe that we did..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still can't believe that we did it."
entries.menuText: "I still can't believe that we did it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It wouldn't be possible without yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wouldn't be possible without you."
entries.menuText: "It wouldn't be possible without you."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""You are too kind, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are too kind, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""You actually managed to make me ju..."
entries.dialogueText: "You actually managed to make me jump for joy. At my age!"

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I know my student. I know you. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know my student. I know you. You have the capability to do so much more."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""That's the spirit! We can't be sul..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the spirit! We can't be sulking about our failures for too long. Otherwise we will spiral into despair."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's right. I will do whatever I..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right. I will do whatever I can to leave a good world for the ones who will come after us."
entries.menuText: "That's right. I will do whatever I can to leave a good world for the ones who will come after us."

entries.title: Player: ""When all is said and done, we stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "When all is said and done, we still have failed."
entries.menuText: "When all is said and done, we still have failed."

entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""This country does not need any mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "This country does not need any more despair."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""So... The elections are fast appro..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... The elections are fast approaching."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""How are you feeling about your cha..."
entries.dialogueText: "How are you feeling about your chances?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid coughed again. This time, fo..."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid coughed again. This time, for longer.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will win. No matter what.""

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "I have been in this line of work for many decades now."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I swore an oath to myself years ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swore an oath to myself years ago."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I would quit if I ever felt like I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would quit if I ever felt like I didn't have the physical capability to serve anymore. At that point, I would become a hindrance."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""That time has come, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "That time has come, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""My bones are aching, my hands are..."
entries.dialogueText: "My bones are aching, my hands are shaking, my voice is failing."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Besides, I am sure you can find a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Besides, I am sure you can find a younger minister who is a little more full of life."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He winked at me and chuckled which..."
entries.dialogueText: He winked at me and chuckled which turned into another cough.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I see. Thank you for letting me kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Thank you for letting me know."
entries.menuText: "I see. Thank you for letting me know."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You have been a mentor, a teacher..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have been a mentor, a teacher and a friend. Thank you for your service to this country."
entries.menuText: "You have been a mentor, a teacher and a friend. Thank you for your service to this country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You will be sorely missed, Deivid.""
entries.dialogueText: "You will be sorely missed, Deivid."
entries.menuText: "You will be sorely missed, Deivid."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""It was an honor, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was an honor, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid stood up to leave."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid stood up to leave.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We shook hands."
entries.dialogueText: We shook hands.
entries.menuText: Shake his hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "We hugged."
entries.dialogueText: We hugged.
entries.menuText: Hug Deivid.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Best of luck, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "Best of luck, Anton."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned around and left."
entries.dialogueText: He turned around and left.

entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Before I go, I want to mention som..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I go, I want to mention something."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked around before grabbing my..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked around before grabbing my arm and lowering his voice.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Be careful of the military. I thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful of the military. I think they are planning something."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I have lived long enough to see tw..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have lived long enough to see two coups in my lifetime, and let's just say I have gotten better at recognizing the signs."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""You must remember what happened to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must remember what happened to my father Anton. Just be careful and take care of your family."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Take this as the last piece of adv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take this as the last piece of advice from me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He suddenly raised his voice again."
entries.dialogueText: He suddenly raised his voice again.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""We are probably being watched so I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are probably being watched so I must be very brief."
